name: Scalefield
description: One shape, scaled from almost nothing to overflowing its cell across the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 12%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 38%, 82% 100%, 18% 100%, 0% 38%); clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 38%, 82% 100%, 18% 100%, 0% 38%); -webkit-transform: scale(@calc(0.2 + 1.3 * @x / @X)); transform: scale(@calc(0.2 + 1.3 * @x / @X)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
